summary: Focused frontend regression on Typing Practice (/app/typing) after the useEffect dependency fix (useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load])). Logged in with demo@masterai.com, verified initial text load, mode switching (Words/Quote), new-text button, full typing completion -> result-card -> restart, and absence of any refetch loop. All 5 requested checks PASS. ESLint on TypingPractice.jsx is clean (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps resolved).

ui_bugs.issue: Button label reads 'new text · tab' but pressing the Tab key does not fetch a new text (no keydown handler). Pre-existing, unrelated to this fix - either implement the Tab shortcut or drop '· tab' from the label.

issues: 'Tap here to start typing' overlay pill renders vertically centered on top of the passage text (overlaps line 3) when the hidden input is not focused; slightly obscures the text. Cosmetic/pre-existing.

action_items: Optional (LOW): implement Tab keyboard shortcut for new text or remove '· tab' from the button label.
Optional (LOW): reposition the 'Tap here to start typing' overlay so it does not overlap the passage.
critical_code_review_comments: load = useCallback(async (m = mode) => {...}, [mode]) with useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]) is correct: the callback identity changes only on mode change, so exactly one fetch per mount and one per mode change. Verified 2 requests per mount in dev (React StrictMode double-invoke) and 0 additional requests over 6s idle - no loop.
load() has no catch branch; a failed /typing/random leaves text empty with no error UI (loading is cleared by finally). Consider an error state + retry.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo account; typing attempts were recorded for demo@masterai.com (XP/streak incremented).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Typing flow verification recipe: login via [email-input]/[password-input]/[submit-auth-button] -> auto-lands on /app/typing. Read passage text from '[data-testid="type-over-engine"] .cursor-text > div:last-child' (replace \xa0 with space), click that container then page.keyboard.type(text, delay=6) -> [result-card] + [restart-button] appear. Instrument page.on('request') filtering '/typing/random' to detect refetch loops; expect 2 per mount in dev (StrictMode).
rca_of_the_issue: Original CI failure was an ESLint exhaustive-deps error only. The fix ([load] dependency on a useCallback memoized by [mode]) is behaviourally equivalent; regression testing confirms single fetch per mount/mode-change, no infinite effect loop, and lint is clean.
